title: Machine Learning with Graphs
summary: Graph representation learning, graph neural networks, scaling, spatiotemporal learning, recommender systems, and graph generation.

preliminaries.label: P1
preliminaries.title: Mathematical preliminaries
preliminaries.topics: Vectors and matrices; structured and sparse matrices; eigenvalues and what matrix powers do; matrix calculus.

preliminaries.label: P2
preliminaries.title: Machine-learning preliminaries
preliminaries.topics: Probability and estimators; perceptron and MLP; backpropagation and SGD; convex optimization; reading an experiment.

lectures.title: Introduction to machine learning on graphs
lectures.topics: Graphs as a modeling language; graph representations and task levels; handcrafted structural features; node embeddings; DeepWalk; node2vec.

lectures.title: Graph neural networks
lectures.topics: Convolutions as polynomials in a shift operator; graph signals and diffusion; graph convolutional filters; GCN; message passing; GAT; homophily, over-smoothing, and over-squashing; PyTorch Geometric.

lectures.title: Scaling up graph neural networks
lectures.topics: Why mini-batching fails on graphs; computational graphs; GraphSAGE neighbor sampling; Cluster-GCN; SGC and LightGCN.

lectures.title: Spatiotemporal analysis with graphs
lectures.topics: Time-varying graph signals; the graph Fourier transform; spectral GNNs and ChebConv; reconstruction by optimization and by autoencoder; auto-regressive forecasting; GraphCast.

lectures.title: Recommender systems
lectures.topics: Bipartite user-item graphs; recommendation as link prediction; Recall@k; the binary and BPR losses; collaborative filtering; NGCF; LightGCN.

lectures.title: Graph generation
lectures.topics: Properties of real-world graphs; Erdos-Renyi random graphs; deep generative models; GraphRNN; iterative local expansion by coarsening.

title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
summary: Vision tasks and backbones, detection, segmentation, pose and tracking, foundation and vision–language models, generative models, and deep learning for 3D.

lectures.title: From pixels to structured scene understanding
lectures.topics: Computer-vision recap; CNN and Vision Transformer backbones; object detection, from anchors to DETR; semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation; human pose estimation; multi-object tracking.

lectures.title: From detection to multi-object tracking
lectures.topics: Pretrained detectors, evaluation, and a tracking-by-detection pipeline.

lectures.title: Foundation models
lectures.topics: Foundation models; contrastive and vision–language learning.

lectures.lecturer: Jhony H. Giraldo and Stephan Alaniz
lectures.title: Foundation models
lectures.topics: Hands-on work with vision foundation models. First written test in the second half.

lectures.title: Generative foundation models and language models
lectures.topics: Generative foundation models and language models.

lectures.title: Deep learning for 3D
lectures.topics: Deep learning on meshes and point clouds.

lectures.title: 3D deep learning
lectures.topics: Hands-on 3D deep learning. Second written test in the second half.
